run_BYOL_training: run BYOL self-supervised learning training on CIFAR10, CIFAR100, or STL10 datasets using a ResNet18 backbone
run_SimCLR_training: run SimCLR self-supervised learning training on CIFAR10, CIFAR100, or STL10 datasets using a ResNet18 backbone
run_linear_evaluation: run linear evaluation on trained self-supervised features using the linear_eval function after training completes
convert_hydra_config_to_dict: convert a Hydra DictConfig object to a standard Python dictionary using the hydra2dict recursive function
load_pretrained_weights: load pre-trained ResNet18 weights from a checkpoint file into the online network for continued training
